note: Risk register as data. Likelihood and impact: 1 (low) to 5 (high). Score = likelihood x impact. Treatment: reduce, accept, transfer, avoid. Initial entries from known risks; to be completed in the gap analysis.

risks.title: Leak of a credential (database, registry, payment, GitHub App)
risks.plan: Rotation runbook, secret guard, short-lived tokens

risks.title: Personal information exposed by a product
risks.plan: Retention and purge tests, incident procedure

risks.title: Loss of data without a working restore
risks.plan: Scheduled backups and one tested restore

risks.title: Supplier outage or breach (hosting, CDN, GPU, payments, e-mail)
